verdict.rationale: SavvyCal is a calendar and scheduling product, so AI task time-blocking is a fair axis to judge it on. Its evidence covers only booking links, availability rules, round robin, polls and workflows, not AI that places tasks into calendar blocks or re-plans them when things change. Adjacent features do not count: time-budget events that restrict link availability, limits on how close meetings sit to each other, workflow steps that move when a meeting is rescheduled, and the MCP client for booking meetings from a chat.
